Leah: Quick pulse on LatticeCore onboarding — we're seeing 95th percentile tail spikes up to 1.8s during the 9–11am window. Hit rate to compact model is 60%.
Devon: Thanks for flagging. Any change in prompt length distribution?
Leah: Slight increase; median tokens ~140 -> 170. Also observed more long-form summarization calls.
Marta: Could be KV cache misses + batching issues. Their route policy still pins to high-accuracy model on ~10% of calls.
Ibrahim: Suggestion: try int8 quantized variant of the compact model first, enable KV prefix caching for session ids, and relax routing threshold to allow compact model for <3s latency tolerance.
Leah: Can you sketch the rollout plan? We want to avoid quality regressions — renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks.
Devon: Plan proposal:
- Canary 5% traffic to int8 compact variant for 24h
- Enable KV cache for sessions that have >1 request within 30s
- Monitor rouge/accuracy on prompt set A (10k samples)
- If no regression, ramp to 40% over 48h
Marta: Add a fallback policy: if compact model latency >1.2s for 5s window, route to base model for that user session.
Ibrahim: Operational changes (commands):
`redwood deploy --project latticecore --model compact-v2-int8 --canary 0.05`
`redwood routing update --project latticecore --policy relax-compact --threshold 0.03`
`redwood cache configure --project latticecore --kv --ttl 60`
Leah: Can we also precompute embeddings for long prompts to reduce tokenization cost? Might shave ~10% cost.
Devon: Good call. We'll prepare eval dashboard and a quick SMS to AE if any metric crosses threshold (latency or quality).
ops-bot: @channel Canary started: compact-v2-int8 -> 5% at 2026-03-22T15:40Z
Marta: I'll own metric checks for the first 6 hours. Ibrahim you ok to own rollback logic?
Ibrahim: Yep. If quality drops >1.5% or latency increases, I'll rollback and post a short postmortem.
Leah: Thanks all — I'll brief customer in the renewal sync tomorrow. Tag me with any customer-facing notes.
Devon: Will add notes to the enablement document and link example prompts. :white_check_mark:
Leah: +1 :thumbsup:
